description: Fields set by environment variables are ignored. The change is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.

anubis_upstream.description: Default Anubis upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

anubis_custom_images.description: Use the custom Anubis images from /data/anubis (env AUTH_REQUEST_ANUBIS_USE_CUSTOM_IMAGES)
